claims.owner: Still on `main` `5d8f8a3`: the health line hard-codes `cronExpression: "*/20 * * * *"` / `expectedMinutes: 20`. `collect.yml` has declared `7,27,47` + `13,43` since PR #54, and after T55 the cadence on `main` is the relay's 15-minute grid.

F-67's title "a workflow cannot rescue its own cadence" is right about a post-commit self-dispatch, but T55 keeps the cadence from inside one long run and hands over with a documented `workflow_dispatch`.

Live probes 2026-11-21 between 20:22Z and 20:32Z: `GET /markets/KXELECTIRAN-26JUL01` still returns 200 for a market settled 2026-07-01, before `GET /historical/cutoff` `market_settled_ts 2026-09-22T00:00:00Z`; the docs say such markets "will not appear".

The docs sentence F-68 quotes is verbatim (re-read 21:06Z), but this repository's records disagree with its conclusion that collector snapshots were "NEVER deployed": `GET /repos/kanlerxz87-cyber/KalshiDash3/pages/builds` lists **29 of the last 96 legacy builds pushed by `github-actions[bot]`**, e.g. `276d356` 15:21:26Z, `c43667f` 20:27:28Z and `a96b7de` 20:58:46Z (pushed by `schedule` run [44948960463](https://github.com/kanlerxz87-cyber/KalshiDash3/actions/runs/44948960463)). The 5-hour staleness was the absence of collector runs, not undeployed commits.

It dispatches with `gh workflow run collect.yml --ref main --event workflow_dispatch`, and `gh workflow run` has **no `--event` flag**: [cli/cli `run.go` L138–141](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/workflow/run/run.go#L138-L141) defines only `--ref`, `--field`, `--raw-field` and `--json` (latest release v2.105.0, 2026-11-18). Local gh 2.23.0 rejects it with "unknown flag: --event". Every alarm dispatch would therefore take the "dispatch failed" branch.
They describe a "20-minute" collector cadence. `collect.yml` has declared `7,27,47` + `13,43` since PR #54, and after T55 `main` collects on a 15-minute grid.
